summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, an updated Sonnet-tier model with improved agentic performance approaching Opus-class capability at $2/$10 per million input/output tokens.

mechanisms.reason: A mid-tier model now delivers near-flagship capability at a fraction of the flagship's price, lowering the effective cost per unit of capability.
mechanisms.quote: its performance is close to that of Opus 4.8, but at lower prices

mechanisms.reason: Higher-effort agentic use and expanded rate limits point to greater token consumption per task and in aggregate.
mechanisms.quote: We"ve increased rate limits across Chat, Cowork, Claude Code, and the Claude Platform to accommodate the higher token usage of higher effort levels

mechanisms.reason: The release is explicitly positioned around autonomous multi-step task completion and tool use displacing manual workflows, per customer testimonials.
mechanisms.quote: Claude Sonnet 5 gives our agents a strong execution layer for multi-step software engineering work.

mechanisms.reason: The document claims a substantial jump in agentic reasoning, tool use and coding performance over the prior Sonnet version, narrowing the gap to the flagship model.
mechanisms.quote: It"s a substantial improvement over its predecessor, Sonnet 4.6, on important aspects of agentic performance like reasoning, tool use, coding, and knowledge work
